# Omni HR | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | Provide modular HRIS to multinational teams in Asia, local remuneration, custodial remuneration and EOR. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | TCO will need to be calculated on a case-by-case basis after the module overlap; pay coverage and filing depth will vary from country to country; EOR and the legal responsibility for software services will be examined separately. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | After the module is superseded, TCO will need to be itemized; pay coverage and filing depth will vary from country to country; EOR and the legal responsibility for software services will be reviewed separately. |
